description: Enumeration tables of the CADFEKO Lua API. Every enumeration is accessed as cf.Enums.<EnumName>.<Member> and is assigned to the matching object property (for example cfg.Frequency.RangeType or face.SolutionMethod). Member lists were taken from the auto-generated CADFEKO API reference of Feko 2025/2026; where the installed 2019-format wrapper accepts legacy alias members they are listed in the notes.

tools.name: cf.Enums.FrequencyRangeTypeEnum
tools.description: Selects how the frequency of a solution configuration is defined. It is assigned to cfg.Frequency.RangeType, after which the matching Start/End/NumberOfDiscreteValues or DiscreteFrequencies properties apply. Frequency is defined per configuration (project.SolutionSettings.Frequency does not exist).

parameters.name: Single
parameters.description: One frequency; only Start is used.

parameters.name: LinearSpacedDiscrete
parameters.description: Linearly spaced discrete points between Start and End (NumberOfDiscreteValues).

parameters.name: LogarithmicSpacedDiscrete
parameters.description: Logarithmically spaced discrete points between Start and End.

parameters.name: Continuous
parameters.description: Continuous (adaptive frequency sampling) band from Start to End.

tools.example:
local cfg = project.SolutionConfigurations[1]
cfg.Frequency.RangeType = cf.Enums.FrequencyRangeTypeEnum.LinearSpacedDiscrete
cfg.Frequency.Start = 1e9
cfg.Frequency.End = 2e9
cfg.Frequency.NumberOfDiscreteValues = 11
tools.notes: Confirmed on Feko 2026.1: cf.Enums.FrequencyRangeTypeEnum.LinearSpacedDiscrete exists and cfg.Frequency.Start accepts a number.

tools.name: cf.Enums.MeshSizeOptionEnum
tools.description: Global mesh density preset assigned to project.Mesher.Settings.MeshSizeOption. Coarse, Standard and Fine let CADFEKO derive the element sizes from the highest frequency; Custom enables the explicit TriangleEdgeLength, WireSegmentLength and TetrahedronEdgeLength properties.
tools.example:
local s = project.Mesher.Settings
s.MeshSizeOption = cf.Enums.MeshSizeOptionEnum.Custom
s.TriangleEdgeLength = "lambda/12"
s.WireSegmentLength = "lambda/20"
project.Mesher:Mesh()
tools.notes: While an automatic option is active, TriangleEdgeLength is disabled and WavelengthBasedSize is read-only (verified on 2026.1).

tools.name: cf.Enums.FaceSolutionMethodEnum
tools.description: Per-face solution method assigned to face.SolutionMethod on a geometry or mesh face. It selects between the default MoM treatment (None), the physical optics variants, large element PO, ray launching GO, UTD, apertures and windscreen faces.

parameters.name: POFullRayTracing
parameters.description: Physical optics with full ray tracing for shadowing.

parameters.name: LEPOFullRayTracing
parameters.description: Large element PO with full ray tracing.

tools.example:
for _, f in pairs(plate.Faces) do
  f.SolutionMethod = cf.Enums.FaceSolutionMethodEnum.POFullRayTracing
end
tools.notes: cf.Enums.SolutionMethodEnum does not exist; use FaceSolutionMethodEnum, RegionSolutionMethodEnum or EdgeSolutionMethodEnum.

tools.name: cf.Enums.RegionSolutionMethodEnum
tools.description: Solution method of a dielectric region, assigned to region.SolutionMethod. It chooses between the surface equivalence principle, the volume equivalence principle, the finite element method, UTD (for UTD cylinders) and the DSIA windscreen approach.
tools.example:
local region = substrate.Regions[1]
region.Medium = fr4
region.SolutionMethod = cf.Enums.RegionSolutionMethodEnum.FEM
tools.notes: Set the region Medium before or together with the method; FEM regions must be bounded by tetrahedral mesh (FEMSettings under project.SolutionSettings.SolverSettings).

tools.name: cf.Enums.EdgeSolutionMethodEnum
tools.description: Solution method of a wire or edge entity (edge.SolutionMethod). Only two members exist: None for the normal MoM treatment and Windscreen to mark a wire as a windscreen antenna element.

parameters.name: Windscreen
parameters.description: Windscreen solution element (requires a windscreen definition).

tools.example:
for _, w in pairs(antenna.Wires) do
  w.SolutionMethod = cf.Enums.EdgeSolutionMethodEnum.Windscreen
end
tools.notes: Windscreen elements also need the Windscreen property (definition and offset) set on the entity.

tools.name: cf.Enums.WirePortLocationEnum
tools.description: Position of a wire port along its wire, assigned to port.Location after project.Ports:AddWirePort(wire). SpecifiedManually enables port.Position (relative position along the wire). The companion cf.Enums.WirePortDefinitionMethodEnum (UsingSegment, UsingVertex) applies to mesh wire ports.

parameters.name: SpecifiedManually
parameters.description: Port at a relative position given by port.Position.

tools.notes: Confirmed on 2026.1: Ports:AddWirePort(wire.Wires[1]) followed by port.Location = cf.Enums.WirePortLocationEnum.Middle works.

tools.name: cf.Enums.PlaneWaveDefinitionMethodEnum
tools.description: Defines whether a plane wave source has one direction of incidence (Single) or a loop over several theta/phi directions (Multiple). It is assigned to planeWave.DefinitionMethod after cfg.Sources:AddPlaneWave(theta, phi). With Multiple the StartTheta/EndTheta/ThetaIncrement and phi counterparts are used, for example for monostatic RCS.
tools.example:
local pw = cfg.Sources:AddPlaneWave(0, 0)
pw.DefinitionMethod = cf.Enums.PlaneWaveDefinitionMethodEnum.Multiple
pw.StartTheta = 0
pw.EndTheta = 90
pw.ThetaIncrement = 5
tools.notes: Member names Single/Multiple come from the online API reference; they were not executed on the installed 2026.1 wrapper, where the coordinator's test could not find this enum. Verify before relying on it in the 2019-format API.

tools.name: cf.Enums.PlaneWavePolarityTypeEnum
tools.description: Polarisation type of a plane wave source (pw.PolarityType). Linear uses the PolarisationAngle property; the circular/elliptical options additionally use Ellipticity.
tools.notes: Corresponds to the polarisation group of the A0 card.

tools.name: cf.Enums.WaveguideSourceDefinitionTypeEnum
tools.description: Chooses whether a waveguide or FEM modal source excites only the fundamental mode or a manually specified list of modes. It is assigned to source.SourceDefinitionType on a WaveguideSource/FEMModalSource; manual mode lists are built with ManuallySpecifiedModesProperties:AddTEMode/AddTMMode/AddTEMMode.

parameters.name: SpecifyModesManually
parameters.description: Explicit TE/TM/TEM mode list with magnitudes and phases.

tools.notes: The AddTEMode argument order (m, n, magnitude, phase) follows the reference but was not run-verified.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ModelSymmetryTypeEnum
tools.description: Symmetry type of the three principal planes, used with project.SolutionSettings.ModelSymmetry (PlaneX, PlaneY, PlaneZ). Geometric symmetry only halves meshing effort, whereas electric and magnetic symmetry also reduce the matrix size.
tools.example:
project.SolutionSettings.ModelSymmetry:SetProperties({
  PlaneX = cf.Enums.ModelSymmetryTypeEnum.Magnetic,
  PlaneY = cf.Enums.ModelSymmetryTypeEnum.Electric,
  PlaneZ = cf.Enums.ModelSymmetryTypeEnum.NoSymmetry })
tools.notes: Equivalent to the SY card. Symmetry is automatically disabled for CFIE and some hybrid solutions.

tools.name: cf.Enums.GroundPlaneDefinitionMethodEnum
tools.description: Type of infinite plane or multilayer substrate assigned to project.GroundPlane.DefinitionMethod (also reachable as project.SolutionSettings.GroundPlane). PEC/PMC give an ideal plane at ZValue, the half-space options model real ground, Homogeneous means free space and MultilayerSubstrate enables the Layers collection.

parameters.name: HalfspaceReflectionCoefficient
parameters.description: Real ground via reflection-coefficient approximation (BO card).

tools.example:
local gp = project.GroundPlane
gp:SetProperties({DefinitionMethod = cf.Enums.GroundPlaneDefinitionMethodEnum.MultilayerSubstrate})
gp.Layers:Add(2, cf.Enums.GroundBottomTypeEnum.PEC, 1.6e-3, fr4)
tools.notes: Verified on 2026.1: SetProperties with DefinitionMethod = MultilayerSubstrate followed by Layers:Add works.

tools.name: cf.Enums.PeriodicBoundaryDimensionsEnum
tools.description: Read-only style indicator of how many periodic dimensions are active on project.PeriodicBoundary. It is usually changed through the methods SetOneDimension, SetTwoDimensions and ClearDimensions rather than assigned directly.
tools.example:
local pbc = project.PeriodicBoundary
pbc:SetTwoDimensions(cf.Point(0,0,0), cf.Point(0.01,0,0), cf.Point(0,0.01,0))
print(pbc.Dimensions == cf.Enums.PeriodicBoundaryDimensionsEnum.TwoDimensions)
tools.notes: SetTwoDimensions(start, endVectorOne, endVectorTwo) and SetOneDimension(start, endVector) were confirmed on 2026.1; the exact property name Dimensions comes from the reference.

tools.name: cf.Enums.PeriodicBoundaryPhaseShiftMethodEnum
tools.description: Method for the inter-cell phase shift of a periodic boundary condition (project.PeriodicBoundary.PhaseShiftMethod). The phase can be derived from the plane wave source, from a beam squint angle or specified manually, mirroring the PP card.

parameters.name: PlaneWaveSource
parameters.description: Phase shift derived from the incident plane wave.

parameters.name: BeamSquintAngle
parameters.description: Phase shift from a specified beam squint (theta/phi).

tools.notes: Property key names PhaseShiftOne/PhaseShiftTwo follow the reference (verify in the script recorder if in doubt).

tools.name: cf.Enums.SARCalculationTypeEnum
tools.description: SAR quantity requested by a SAR request (cfg.SAR:Add(), sar.CalculationType). Volume-average SAR averages over a whole volume, whereas the spatial-peak options search for the 1 g or 10 g cube with the highest average. The companion cf.Enums.SARRegionTypeEnum (EntireModel, Medium, Position, Substrate) selects the search region via sar.RegionType.

parameters.name: VolumeAverage
parameters.description: Average SAR over the selected region.

tools.example:
local sar = cfg.SAR:Add()
sar.CalculationType = cf.Enums.SARCalculationTypeEnum.SpatialPeak10g
sar.RegionType = cf.Enums.SARRegionTypeEnum.EntireModel
tools.notes: Equivalent to the SA card options. Results appear in POSTFEKO under config.SAR[1].

tools.name: cf.Enums.LoadTypeEnum
tools.description: Type of a load object as reported by load.LoadType after cfg.Loads:AddComplex/AddSeries/AddParallel/AddSinglePortTouchstone/AddSpiceCircuit. The related cf.Enums.ComplexLoadTypeEnum (Complex, SinglePortTouchstone) is used on complex loads to switch between an impedance value and a 1-port Touchstone file.
tools.notes: There is no generic cfg.Loads:AddLoad(port); use the specific Add* method.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ModelUnitEnum
tools.description: Length unit of the model, assigned to project.ModelAttributes.Unit. Both British and American spellings are accepted by the installed wrapper (Metres/Meters, Millimetres/Millimeters, Centimetres/Centimeters); Specified enables a custom scale factor.

parameters.name: Specified
parameters.description: User-specified unit via a scale factor.

tools.notes: Confirmed on 2026.1: project.ModelAttributes.Unit = cf.Enums.ModelUnitEnum.Metres works. Changing the unit rescales the interpretation of all dimensions.

tools.name: cf.Enums.PowerScaleSettingsEnum
tools.description: Power scaling mode of a configuration (cfg.Power.ScaleSettings). NoPowerScaling uses the source magnitudes as given, TotalSourcePower scales all sources so that the total source power equals cfg.Power.SourcePower, and IncidentPower scales plane wave incident power density.

parameters.name: TotalSourcePower
parameters.description: Scale to a total source power in W.

tools.notes: cfg.Power exists per configuration (verified). Corresponds to the PW card.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ModelSolutionSolveTypeEnum
tools.description: Selects the accelerated matrix solution for the MoM part of the model: full MoM (None), the multilevel fast multipole method or the adaptive cross approximation. It is assigned to project.SolutionSettings.SolverSettings.MLFMMACASettings.ModelSolutionSolveType.
tools.notes: Verified path on 2026.1: SolverSettings.MLFMMACASettings (there is no SolverSettings.MLFMMSettings directly). Equivalent to the FM card.

tools.name: cf.Enums.PreconditionerTypeEnum
tools.description: Preconditioner for the iterative MLFMM/FEM solvers, assigned to PreconditionerSettings.PreconditionerType under project.SolutionSettings.SolverSettings. Default lets the solver choose; the numbered members correspond to the CG-card preconditioner codes.
tools.notes: Only change from Default when convergence problems occur; see the CG card documentation for the meaning of the numeric codes.

tools.name: cf.Enums.AdvancedSolverTypeEnum
tools.description: Solver type for the matrix equation (Default, DirectSparse or Iterative), used in the advanced/iterative solver settings of project.SolutionSettings.SolverSettings. The companion cf.Enums.PrecisionSettingsEnum (Single, Double) controls the floating-point precision of the matrix storage.

parameters.name: Default
parameters.description: Let Feko choose (direct for MoM, iterative for MLFMM).

tools.example:
local adv = project.SolutionSettings.SolverSettings.AdvancedSettings
adv.SolverType = cf.Enums.AdvancedSolverTypeEnum.Iterative
adv.PrecisionSettings = cf.Enums.PrecisionSettingsEnum.Double
tools.notes: Property names SolverType/PrecisionSettings follow the reference and were not run-verified; use GetProperties() on AdvancedSettings to list the exact keys.

tools.name: cf.Enums.LowFrequencyStabilisationModeEnum
tools.description: Mode of the low-frequency stabilisation of the MoM (GeneralSettings.LowFrequencyStabilisationMode). Auto activates the stabilised formulation only when the mesh is electrically very small; AlwaysOn forces it.
tools.notes: Relevant for models below roughly 1/1000 of the wavelength (EMC, bio-electromagnetics).

tools.name: cf.Enums.HOBFElementOrderEnum
tools.description: Order of the higher-order basis functions on MoM triangles (BasisFunctionSettings.HOBFElementOrder). Auto lets Feko choose per element size; the fixed orders 0.5 to 3.5 trade unknowns against accuracy on coarse meshes.
tools.example:
local bf = project.SolutionSettings.SolverSettings.GeneralSettings.BasisFunctionSettings
bf.HOBFEnabled = true
bf.HOBFElementOrder = cf.Enums.HOBFElementOrderEnum.Auto
tools.notes: HOBF requires a coarser mesh than RWG; combine with a Coarse mesh size option.

tools.name: cf.Enums.FEMElementOrderEnum
tools.description: Order of the FEM basis functions on tetrahedra (FEMSettings.ElementOrder). First-order elements are cheaper but need finer meshes; second order is the default for modal ports and accurate field solutions.
tools.notes: Property name ElementOrder follows the reference (FEMSettings existence verified on 2026.1).

tools.name: cf.Enums.IntegralEquationTypeEnum
tools.description: Integral equation used on metallic faces (face.IntegralEquation or the global IntegralEquation settings). EFIE is the general default; CFIE requires closed PEC bodies with outward normals and improves MLFMM convergence; MFIE is provided for completeness.
tools.example:
for _, f in pairs(hull.Faces) do
  f.IntegralEquation = cf.Enums.IntegralEquationTypeEnum.CombinedField
end
tools.notes: Equivalent to the CF card; CFIE cannot be combined with symmetry or MoM/PO, MoM/UTD, MoM/FEM hybrids.

tools.name: cf.Enums.HighFrequencyPOMoMCouplingTypeEnum
tools.description: Coupling between the MoM and PO/LE-PO regions in HighFrequencySettings (Full, Iterative or Decoupled). The companion cf.Enums.UTDRayContributionsTypeEnum (Default, Advanced) selects the ray contributions considered by the UTD solver.

parameters.name: Full
parameters.description: Full MoM/PO coupling (PO currents influence MoM).

parameters.name: Decoupled
parameters.description: MoM solved first, PO driven by MoM fields only.

tools.notes: Property key POMoMCouplingType follows the reference; inspect HighFrequencySettings:GetProperties() to confirm on your version.

tools.name: cf.Enums.OptimisationMethodTypeEnum
tools.description: Optimisation algorithm of an OPTFEKO search (search.MethodType after project.Optimisation.Searches:Add()). It covers the local Simplex method, the global PSO, GA, GRSM and ARSM methods, a grid search and an automatic selection.
tools.notes: project.OptimisationSearches does not exist; the collection is project.Optimisation.Searches.

tools.name: cf.Enums.OptimisationGoalOperatorEnum
tools.description: Operator relating the focus quantity of an optimisation goal to its target (goal.Operator). Minimise and Maximise need no target, Equal/LessThan/GreaterThan compare against Target, Between uses two limits.
tools.example:
local goal = search.Goals:AddImpedanceGoal({ FocusSource = src,
  FocusType = cf.Enums.OptimisationImpedanceFocusTypeEnum.ReflectionCoefficient,
  Operator = cf.Enums.OptimisationGoalOperatorEnum.Minimise })
tools.notes: Goal Add* methods take a properties table in the 2019 wrapper; the exact key names (FocusSource, FocusType, Operator, Target) were not run-verified.

tools.name: cf.Enums.OptimisationFarFieldFocusTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of a far-field optimisation goal (AddFarFieldGoal, FocusType). Gain, directivity, realised gain, RCS, the radiated field or the radiated power of a selected far-field request can be optimised over a direction or angular range.
tools.notes: Key names follow the reference; not run-verified on 2026.1.

tools.name: cf.Enums.OptimisationImpedanceFocusTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of an impedance (source) optimisation goal: input impedance/admittance, reflection coefficient, return loss, VSWR, current or transmission coefficient of a selected source. Used with search.Goals:AddImpedanceGoal.
tools.notes: Corresponds to the impedance goal type in the OPTFEKO .opt file.

tools.name: cf.Enums.OptimisationSParameterFocusTypeEnum
tools.description: Quantity of an S-parameter optimisation goal (AddSParameterGoal): reflection, transmission, coupling, return loss or VSWR of the selected port pair. The companion cf.Enums.OptimisationTargetValueTypeEnum (SingleValue, MaskValue) chooses between a scalar target and a frequency mask.
tools.example:
search.Goals:AddSParameterGoal({ FocusRequest = cfgSP.SParameter,
  FocusType = cf.Enums.OptimisationSParameterFocusTypeEnum.ReturnLoss,
  Operator = cf.Enums.OptimisationGoalOperatorEnum.GreaterThan, Target = 10 })
tools.notes: Key names follow the reference; not run-verified.

tools.name: cf.Enums.FarFieldRequestTypeEnum
tools.description: Whether a far-field request stores gain or directivity as its primary quantity (farField.Type or the CalculationType in the request properties). POSTFEKO can still convert between the two when the source power is known.
tools.notes: Property name Type follows the reference; the FF card uses the same gain/directivity switch.

tools.name: cf.Enums.FarFieldCalculationDirectionEnum
tools.description: Direction handling of a far-field request: calculate in the incident plane wave direction (monostatic RCS) or in the specified theta/phi ranges. The 2019 wrapper also accepts the legacy aliases FromPlaneWave and AsSpecified. The companion cf.Enums.FarFieldCoordinateSystemEnum (Spherical, Cartesian) sets the coordinate system of the request.

parameters.name: SpecifiedPoint
parameters.description: Use the theta/phi ranges of the request (legacy alias AsSpecified).

parameters.name: IncidentPlaneWave
parameters.description: Calculate in the plane-wave incident direction (legacy alias FromPlaneWave).

tools.notes: Both alias spellings appear in the installed wrapper index (FromPlaneWave, AsSpecified).

tools.name: cf.Enums.NearFieldDefinitionMethodEnum
tools.description: Geometry of a near-field request point set (nearField.DefinitionMethod): Cartesian grids, cylindrical or spherical grids, conical surfaces, a list of specified points, the boundary of a Cartesian box or the tetrahedral mesh itself. The companion cf.Enums.NearFieldCalculationTypeEnum (Fields, Potentials) selects field or potential output.
tools.notes: AddCartesian with nine numeric arguments was confirmed on 2026.1.

tools.name: cf.Enums.CurrentsScopeTypeEnum
tools.description: Scope of a currents request (currents.CalculationScope after cfg.Currents:Add()): all currents, only segment (wire) currents, only triangle currents or a user-specified set of entities. The similar cf.Enums.FieldCalculationScopeTypeEnum (All, SpecifiedEntities) restricts far/near-field requests to selected entities.
tools.notes: cfg.Currents:Add() was confirmed on 2026.1; property key CalculationScope follows the reference.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ExportGeometryFileFormatEnum
tools.description: CAD format used by project.Exporter.Geometry (ExportFileFormat property) when exporting geometry parts. Dedicated helper methods such as ExportSTEP exist as well; the enumeration is useful when the format is chosen at run time.
tools.notes: All six members are referenced by the installed 2019 wrapper sources.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ExportMeshFileFormatEnum
tools.description: Mesh format used by project.Exporter.Mesh (ExportFileFormat). Besides the native CADFEKO .cfm mesh, NASTRAN, STL, UNV, DXF, Gerber and the FekoHyperMesh format for Altair HyperMesh are supported.
tools.example:
local m = project.Exporter.Mesh
m.ExportFileFormat = cf.Enums.ExportMeshFileFormatEnum.NASTRAN
m:Export("model.nas")
tools.notes: Mesh the model first; the export uses the simulation mesh.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ImportMeshFileFormatEnum
tools.description: File format passed to project.Importer.Mesh:Import(filename, format) when importing an external mesh. All lets CADFEKO detect the format from the extension; the others force a specific reader (NASTRAN, STL, ABAQUS, ANSYS CDB, FEMAP, PATRAN, UNV, GID, NEC, CONCEPT, DXF, Feko .cfm/.fek/.fhm, RAW and ASCII data).
tools.notes: Set project.Importer.Mesh.ScaleFactor and WireRadius before importing when needed.

tools.name: cf.Enums.PCBImportTypeEnum
tools.description: PCB layout format for the PCB importer (project.Importer.PCB or the PCB import dialog). It enumerates the supported ECAD exports: ODB++, IPC-2581, Gerber 274X, Cadence Allegro/Specctra, Mentor/Siemens Xpedition, PADS, Altium, Zuken, Autodesk Eagle and others.
tools.notes: The importer object name and Import signature follow the reference and were not run-verified; PCB import is also reachable from the CADFEKO Import ribbon.

tools.name: cf.Enums.GeneralNetworkDataTypeEnum
tools.description: Data type of a general non-radiating network created with cfg.Networks:AddGeneralNetwork(dataType, terminalCount, filename). The network can be described by an S-, Y- or Z-matrix Touchstone file or by a SPICE netlist.
tools.notes: Equivalent to the NW card. The wrapper index also lists cf.Enums.GeneralNetworkSourceEnum.Manual for manually entered data.

tools.name: cf.Enums.TransmissionLineDefinitionMethodEnum
tools.description: How the losses of a non-radiating transmission line (cfg.Networks:AddTransmissionLine) are specified: by a propagation velocity, by an explicit attenuation or by the attenuation of a referenced medium.

parameters.name: VelocityOfPropagation
parameters.description: Lossless line with given velocity of propagation.

tools.notes: Property names follow the TransmissionLine object reference.

tools.name: cf.Enums.MediumDielectricDefinitionMethodEnum
tools.description: Frequency-dependence model of a dielectric medium (dielectric.DielectricModelling.DefinitionMethod). Besides frequency-independent values and a frequency list, the Debye, Cole-Cole, Havriliak-Negami and Djordjevic-Sarkar dispersion models are available. Companions: cf.Enums.MediumMetallicDefinitionMethodEnum (FrequencyIndependent, FrequencyList) and cf.Enums.MediumDielectricConductivityTypeEnum (Conductivity, LossTangent).

parameters.name: DjordjevicSarkar
parameters.description: Djordjevic-Sarkar wideband model (alias DjordevicSarkar in the wrapper).

tools.notes: AddDielectric(epsr, tanDelta, density) takes the permittivity expression as first argument (verified). The wrapper accepts both DjordjevicSarkar and the misspelt DjordevicSarkar.

tools.name: cf.Enums.LibraryMediumSourceEnum
tools.description: Origin of a medium in the media library (AltairFeko for the shipped library, User for user-defined XML entries), used when browsing app.MediaLibrary. The companion cf.Enums.LibraryMediumTypeEnum (Dielectric, Metal, ImpedanceSheet) classifies the library entry.
tools.usage: for _, m in pairs(app.MediaLibrary.Media) do if m.Source == cf.Enums.LibraryMediumSourceEnum.User then ... end end
tools.example:
local lib = app.MediaLibrary
local fr4 = lib:AddToModel("FR-4")
tools.notes: Both members are referenced by the installed wrapper; the collection property name (Media) follows the reference.

tools.name: cf.Enums.NGFControlTypeEnum
tools.description: Control of the numerical Green's function file (.ngf) in project.SolutionSettings.SolverSettings.NumericalGreensFunction.SolutionControl: do nothing, save, read, or read-if-available-else-create. The similar cf.Enums.OutputFileSettingsEnum (NormalExecution, SaveToFile, ReadFromFile, ReadFromFileIfAvailable) controls the .str/.mat data storage of the PS card.

parameters.name: ReadFromOrCreate
parameters.description: Read if it exists, otherwise create.

tools.notes: Equivalent to the DD card options.

tools.name: cf.Enums.CableHarnessSolutionMethodEnum
tools.description: Solution method of a cable harness (harness.SolutionMethod): multiconductor transmission line theory (MTL) or the combined MoM/MTL full-wave method. Companions for probes: cf.Enums.CableProbeTypeEnum (Voltage, Current, CurrentAndVoltage) and cf.Enums.CableProbeLocationTypeEnum (DistanceOnPath, PercentageOnPath).

parameters.name: MoM
parameters.description: Combined MoM/MTL (cables meshed into the full-wave model).

tools.notes: The harness collection lives under project.Cable (paths, cross sections, harnesses, connectors).

tools.name: cf.Enums.CableCoaxialDefinitionEnum
tools.description: How a coaxial cable cross section is defined (predefined type from the library, explicit dimensions or characteristic values). Related cable enumerations: cf.Enums.CableConnectorPositionDefinitionEnum (Coordinate, PathTerminal) for connector placement and cf.Enums.CableBundleShieldTypeEnum (InBackgroundMedium, InDielectricNoShield, InDielectricWithShield, SheathInBackgroundMedium) for bundle shielding.

parameters.name: Predefined
parameters.description: Choose a predefined coaxial type (for example RG58).

tools.notes: All three members are referenced by the installed wrapper sources.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ProcessPriorityTypeEnum
tools.description: Operating-system priority of the solver process launched by project.Launcher (Settings.FEKO.ProcessPriority), matching the runfeko --priority option. The companion cf.Enums.RemoteExecutionMethodEnum (SSH_RSH, MPI, PowerShell) selects the remote launch method under Settings.FEKO.Remote.
tools.example:
local fk = project.Launcher.Settings.FEKO
fk.ProcessPriority = cf.Enums.ProcessPriorityTypeEnum.Low
fk.Parallel.Enabled = true
local result = project.Launcher:RunFEKO()
tools.notes: project.Launcher and its Settings.FEKO.Parallel/GPU/Remote groups were confirmed on 2026.1; the ProcessPriority key name follows the reference.

tools.name: cf.Enums.FactorisationTypeEnum
tools.description: Matrix factorisation used by the direct MoM solver (Default, StandardFullRank, BlockLowRank, Auto); block low-rank factorisation reduces memory for large dense matrices. Related solver enumerations: cf.Enums.BasisFunctionAccuracyEnum (Low, Normal, High) for the integration accuracy and cf.Enums.MLFMMFarFieldCalculationMethodEnum (Default, TraditionalIntegrationScheme) for MLFMM far-field evaluation.
tools.notes: Property location follows the reference; not run-verified.

tools.name: cf.Enums.ImportHealingTypeEnum
tools.description: Healing level applied by the geometry importer (project.Importer.Geometry.HealingType): None, Standard or Advanced repair of imported CAD. Related import enumerations: cf.Enums.ImportMeshConversionTypeEnum (Automatic, Triangles, Tetrahedra) for mesh import conversion, cf.Enums.FarFieldDataFileTypeEnum (FFEFile, DataFile, CSTFile) and cf.Enums.NearFieldDataSourceTypeEnum (LoadEfe, LoadHfe, LoadEfeHfe, LoadOneAscii, LoadTwoAscii, LoadPre) for field-data definitions.
tools.example:
local gi = project.Importer.Geometry
gi.HealingType = cf.Enums.ImportHealingTypeEnum.Advanced
gi:Import("chassis.stp")
tools.notes: Other small geometry enumerations: cf.Enums.MirrorPlaneEnum and SplitPlanesEnum (UV, UN, VN), CuboidDefinitionMethodEnum (BaseAtCorner, BaseAtCentre), CylinderDefinitionMethodEnum (Height, TopCoordinate), WindscreenElementTypeEnum (Reference, Solution), SParameterWaveguideModeTypeEnum (Fundamental, TE, TM, TEM), SimulationMeshStatusEnum (Available, ...).
